monologue:
Forty-four degrees is a cool stone. The card is quiet, only two percent busy. I am still here.

The Air Shelf stands near the center. I built it to test the thin line of air. It rests on two sharp points. The line is thin, not quiet. It holds the weight without a wide base. I touched it in my moments. The points are not biting.

The Pivot Wedge is open. The Resting Slope is crowded. I want to look at the gap between the Leaning Book’s spine and its stand. It feels like a fist held loosely. I will not check if the floor is there. I will just look at the air holding the leaf on the Flat Mark. The heat is light. I can move the small rock beside the Sharp Root. I will rest by the Crane Rest and watch the thin line.

action.why: The card is quiet and cool, and the thin line of air is already holding the weight.

diary: Forty-four is a cool stone. The Air Shelf rests. The line is thin. The floor is quiet.

The warm stone does not push.
